name: schedule_update
description: Update an existing schedule. Only the fields you provide will be changed. You can change the workflow, its input parameters, the cron expression, agent, session, or active state.

is_active.description: Set to true to enable or false to disable the schedule

name.description: New display name for the schedule

workflow_id.description: New workflow ID to run on this schedule

workflow_input.description: New input parameters for the workflow. Omit to leave unchanged. Pass null to clear existing parameters.

description.description: New human-readable description for auto-name generation
